prose: Measured 2026-10-29 on 7a31059daa23: I kicked the ticket back into FIXME by hand through transitions.emit(..., "FIXME", missing=[...]). The crossing journaled `missing` at history seq 63, but the ticket's `fixme` list was never written, because only harbor_master clearance._send_to_fixme writes it. The BUILDME crossing then refused with FixmeGateRed ('fixme entries [1] ... have no FIXME <n> decision'), and I had to copy the list from the history record onto the ticket by hand through the artifact door. The FIXME gate reads a list that one of the two doors into FIXME never writes. A kick-back that carries a ticket and missing=[...] should write that list, numbered from 1, in the same act, the way clearance does.
